title: Offline receipt sync
objective: Queue receipts captured offline and upload them when connectivity returns without loss or duplication.

currentCode.text: SyncEngine is a @MainActor @Observable class holding receipts in memory.

architecture.summary: A SyncQueue actor owns pending uploads; the main-actor engine mirrors snapshots.

stateOwnership.text: SyncQueue (actor) owns the pending list; SyncEngine mirrors a read-only snapshot on the main actor.

persistence.text: Pending receipts persist in SwiftData with a schemaVersion field.

concurrency.text: Uploads run in a TaskGroup; cancellation keeps the queue intact.

privacy.text: The bearer token lives in the Keychain and never enters logs or source.

failureHandling.text: Upload failures mark the receipt failed with retry; the queue is never dropped.

migration.text: First launch migrates in-memory receipts to SwiftData; stores without schemaVersion are version 0.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A receipt captured offline is still pending after relaunch.
The receipts screen shows the offline state when unreachable.
The project compiles with strict concurrency checking.

steps.description: Add SyncQueue actor and SwiftData model

unresolved.text: Whether the backend rejects duplicate receipt ids.
